findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/store.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The renderer is placed in athena-cli/src/lib.rs, which only declares modules; command output renderers live in display.rs.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cli/src/lib.rs has only `pub mod backtest; decisions; display; drain; hooks; strategy; wiring;` (lines 4-10). crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs renders command output, e.g. 'audit recorded: records/audits/...' at line 262. Fix: Put the sweep renderer and its tests in display.rs, next to the audit output, and list display.rs as a changed file with this reason. lib.rs is listed but needs no change. Or, if the planner keeps lib.rs to stay inside the list, say that this departs from where renderers usually live.

findings.summary: The `hestia last` command path is not covered by a test; only the renderer is.
findings.evidence: The criterion says 'A CLI test covers both cases' and the command must print an explicit message when no sweep exists. The plan tests the renderer with an Option and shows the main.rs wiring only by a manual `cargo run -- hestia last`. If main.rs printed nothing when last_sweep returned None, every test would still pass. Fix: Have main.rs call one function that takes the Records, or last_sweep's result, and returns the printed text, and test that function in the no-records case. Or record the output of the manual `cargo run -- hestia last` run, both with and without a sweep, as evidence.

findings.summary: The open question about docs that list record directories has an answer to look up.
findings.evidence: `records/audits` is named in docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md, display.rs and CHANGELOG.md. Fix: Check whether roles-and-ladder.md lists every record directory. If it does, ask whether records/hestia-sweeps/ belongs there; otherwise the CHANGELOG mention is enough.

summary: I read store.rs, records.rs, athena-cli's lib.rs and display.rs, and the D129 entry in decisions.md. The plan holds up against them. The edit to store.rs that Athena flagged is needed: Records::load (store.rs:293-325) sends any record it does not list to `job_of(&other).expect("every other record names its job")`. job_of (store.rs:249-266) returns None for anything that is not a per-job record, so a new HestiaSweep variant would panic unless Records::load gets its own arm. The plan names this and gives the reason, so the scope widening is justified. The record pattern the plan copies from Audit is all in records.rs: the schema constant, the serde rename, and the validate, path and schema match arms. No outside schema file is needed. D129 is at decisions.md:3233 with the 'not accepted; the build jobs are not queued' wording the plan says it will remove. The demonstrations would fail without the behavior for criteria 1-5 and 8. Remaining issues are minor. First, the renderer goes into athena-cli/src/lib.rs, which today only declares modules; the existing renderers live in display.rs. Second, the CLI test exercises the renderer but not the `hestia last` wiring, which is shown only by a manual `cargo run`.
